description:
DEQ is seeking a programmer with experience and skills in LOGI Analytics to assist with our Reporting effort. 
 This individual must have a strong background in building scalable, high quality, and high performance application and reporting systems. As a LOGI Analytics developer, the candidate will be involved in the development of application flow diagrams, creating LOGI objects and attributes, debugging, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work with a team of analysts, developers, managers, and business resources to build the capability for business users to develop ad hoc reports. 
 Experience with some combination of HTTP, HTML, XML, CSS, AJAX and JavaScript 
 Experience with .Net web applications 
 Experience with at least one commercial DBMS (Oracle, SQL Server,) 
 Experience in environments with continuous integration and agile software development. 
 Experience with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) 
 Experience in a projects overall system lifecycle development- 
 Good communication skills, must be able to clearly communicate ideas, decisions and reasoning to team members 
 
 Experience with Logi Analytics Products (ad-hoc and LogiInfo)
Ability to create objects and attributes in Logi Analytics
Experience with SQL Server and SQL Server Integration Services
Ability to work independently.
Ability to interact with product users at all levels
Experience with creating custom data views in Oracle 12c


 
 Thanks and Regards, 
 
 
 Jane Morgan
